content:
Alex: kicking off a RoPE cross-model sweep (linear / NTK / YARN) across Llama / Mistral / Mixtral / Qwen. initial note: small ppl drift at very long ctx for some NTK runs. will paste profiling output shortly.
Igor: paste the profiler cmd pls — want to check kernel selection and fallback reasons.
Alex: ran: ```./prof --model=mistral-7b --rope=ntk --ctx=48k --trace=kernels,batching,kv --out=/tmp/mistral-ntk.trace``` hot kernels: mha_fused, kv_store_slowpath, gather_shard_reduce
Maya: when kv_store hits slowpath p95 jumps badly. try changing batching heuristics: lower max_batch_delay to 2ms and increase batch_size_target from 128->256 for longctx flows.
Igor: noted. on Mixtral the selector picks fp16-mha-optim for <=4k seqs but falls back to fp32-mha when kv_fragmentation > 16MB. that fallback correlates with latency cliffs.
Sujay: YARN repro shows KV cache churn due to head-dim aliasing when linear scaling is used. this causes frequent invalidations and perf cliffs. repro:```python tools/repro_longctx.py --model=qwen-7b --rope=yarn --len=40000 --profile```
PerfBot: perf summary (median over 3 runs):
- mistral-ntk@48k: p95=210ms, tokens/s=60, ppl_delta=+0.6
- mixtral-linear@48k: p95=240ms, tokens/s=52, ppl_delta=+1.8
- qwen-yarn@48k: p95=480ms, tokens/s=28, perf_cliff attributed to kv_churn
Maya: proposal: temporary per-model safe caps until runtime KV rebasing is fixed. suggested caps: Llama: 32k (linear), Mistral: 48k (ntk), Mixtral: 32k (linear), Qwen: 24k (yarn).
Alex: agree to cap defaults in runtime config + add auto-fallback policy based on kv_slowpath_rate. rule: if kv_slowpath_rate > 5% in last 60s, switch to rope_variant=linear or reduce ctx window by 50%.
Igor: kernel plan: add a small fp16-compatible KV bridge kernel that handles scaled RoPE multipliers without promoting to fp32. prototype PR coming (runtime/kernels/rope_bridge). should reduce fp32 fallbacks seen on Mixtral.
Sujay: evaluation note: Mixtral NTK at 48k shows +2.0 ppl vs baseline on our heldout longctx set, concentrated on high-amplitude tokens around position 30k-35k. hypothesis: amplitude mismatch from NTK multiplier. adding targeted evals with offset windows and ablations.
Maya: action items:
- Alex: implement auto-fallback policy + config knobs (runtime/routing)
- Igor: prototype fp16 KV bridge kernel (kernels/)
- Sujay: add targeted evals and repro scripts (evals/rope_longctx/)
- PerfBot: schedule nightly 3-run regression matrix for all model x rope_variant x ctx_len and post CSV to #eng-runtime/reports
Alex: also: keep batching conservative for Qwen until kernel bridge lands. push flags to runtime config: qwen.batch_size_target=128 qwen.max_batch_delay=2ms by default. cc @PerfBot
PerfBot: ack — nightly jobs scheduled; will post summarized CSV + per-model safe_range metadata by 06:00 UTC tomorrow.
Igor: small note — kernel selector instrumentation added to protos. we can emit kv_fragmentation bytes and chosen_kernel id to traces which will help automate fallback thresholds.
Sujay: added repro script variants to PR so ops can reproduce perf cliff locally. will include minimal logs and a small sample token stream.
Maya: thanks — once Igor's fp16-bridge is in, we should re-run the Mixtral NTK eval sweep and revisit safe caps.
Alex: slotted as high priority. adding tickets to board and will follow up in next sync.
PerfBot: thread closed for now; will reopen if nightly detects regression >1.5 ppl or p95 increase >20%.
